title: Function Caller
text: Call a Simulink function, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Function name} sets Quali; {Function prototype} sets the function prototype y=f, {Input argument specifications} sets the input argument data type, dimensions, and complexity <Enter, {Output argument specifications} sets the output argument data type, dimensions, and complexity <Enter, {Sample time} sets the time interval between function calls and {Execute function call asynchronously} sets the option to execute function calls. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Input argument
ports.summary: Input signal for input argument scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Output argument
ports.summary: Output signal or message for output argument scalar | vector | matrix | message

params.name: Function prototype
params.values: Specify function prototype y=f(u) (default) | character vector | string

params.name: Function name
params.values: Qualified function name f (default) | character vector | string

params.name: Input argument specifications
params.values: Specify input argument data type, dimensions, and complexity <Enter example> (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Output argument specifications
params.values: Specify output argument data type, dimensions, and complexity <Enter example> (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Time interval between function calls -1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Execute function call asynchronously
params.values: Option to execute function calls asynchronously off (default) | on
